 9:44 PM ET 2 hours ago LA Clippers and Lakers Aim for Their Second Consecutive Win
 The Clippers opened the season with a commanding 121-96 victory over the Sacramento Kings. Garland led the offense in their season opener, while Kawhi Leonard will be another of the visiting team's main offensive threats. After finishing last season with 42 wins and 40 losses, the Clippers aim to establish themselves among the best teams in the Western Conference.
 The Lakers also made a strong start, defeating the Golden State Warriors 127-105. Dončić led the offense with an all-around performance, while Austin Reaves and DeAndre Ayton contributed to the victory. JJ Redick's team will look to take advantage of home-court advantage and maintain its strong start to the season.
 Live updates by Sebastian Raquira Avellaneda
 9:34 PM ET 2 hours ago Players to Watch
 For the Los Angeles Lakers, Luka Dončić will be the player to watch. The Slovenian started the season with 28 points, eight rebounds, and seven assists against the Golden State Warriors. His ability to create plays, take advantage of screens, and find openings against opposing defenses will be crucial to the offense led by JJ Redick.
 For the LA Clippers, Darius Garland will be in the spotlight after scoring 30 points in the victory over the Sacramento Kings. The point guard will be key to the team's offensive creation and perimeter game as Tyronn Lue's squad looks to use his speed and scoring ability to challenge the Lakers' defense.
